theme: Shaadi Season (and a Very Black Friday)

segments.title: November
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! November is Shaadi Season, and a very Black Friday. Half our members have a wedding to dance at, and the other half have a sale to wait for. We have something for both.

segments.title: ₹11.23L
segments.text: So, the number. Our November target for Kenkere House is 11.2 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent more than last November. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 5.95 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 3.82 lakh, everything else 78,600, and comebacks 67,400. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 57 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 847 leads, 305 trials, and 57 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 4.55 lakh rupees, which is 41 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: 11.11: Treat Yourself, Not Your Ex
segments.text: First up, eleven eleven: treat yourself, not your ex. Eleven hours only, eight-class packs at twenty per cent off. One per person. The plan is 8 buyers at about 7,000, so 55,800 rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: newcomers, pack buyers and members.

segments.title: Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too)
segments.text: Next, Bride Squad, Assemble. The groom can come too. Four or more of you, at least two new, buy twelve-class packs together at twelve per cent off and get a private Squad Class that ends on a Sangeet routine. The plan is 8 buyers at about 11,600, so 92,400 rupees.
segments.notes: Wedding parties and friend groups (min 4, at least 2 new).

segments.title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (Come Back Before the Baraat)
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana. Fifteen per cent off to come back, matching Bride Tribe socks, and a seat at the Sangeet Choreo Barre. The plan is 3 buyers at about 12,400, so 37,200 rupees.

segments.title: Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds)
segments.text: And finally, the Black Friday Blind Box. No duds. Renew for three, six or twelve months and pick a sealed box: extra days, guest passes, a private. Every box wins, and one annual box per studio hides the hoodie. The plan is 5 buyers at about 54,000, so 2.7 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing or upgrading; annual renewers due Nov–Jan.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, bride squads and wedding parties get their group rate. Week two, eleven eleven: eleven hours of pack prices, and no exes invited. Week three, the Sangeet Choreo Barre on the twentieth, and lapsed members come back before the baraat. Week four, the Black Friday Blind Box, four days, long plans only, and no duds.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's November at Kenkere House. 11.2 lakh rupees, four offers, and 57 buyers to welcome. Wedding-ready and fully booked. That's November.
segments.signoff: Wedding-ready and fully booked. That's November.
